note: Set A is better due to higher fidelity in text extraction, whereas Set B contains corrupted quotes (e.g., '8 8D' instead of '8D', 'OUGH BOLT' instead of 'THROUGH BOLT'). Both sets have binding errors regarding which detail certain dimensions belong to (Set A attributes A3 dimensions to Railing Attachment; Set B attributes A3 dimensions to Detail A1), but Set B's errors are more numerous and include fundamental text recognition failures.
